Excellent hidden restaurant
Jul 2026 • Couples
At the end of a small, unassuming alley hides a mini restaurant that delighted our taste buds.
It's not the setting you come here for, nor the servers in uniforms, but you come for the food. We had a super dinner, everything was neat, super fresh, and above all, flavorful. My bun bo Hue was a treat with a good spicy broth, and my husband's vegetarian banh khoai were well-filled, crispy, and succulent. We recommend this little hideaway for a delicious meal.
